title: Bridged diheteroaryl-vinylene scaffolds as novel non-fullerene acceptors: a theoretical approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,43808-43817
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04742K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Jordan Garo, Tommaso Nicolini, Jean-Marc Sotiropoulos, Jean-Manuel Raimundo
Vinylene-bridged heteroaryl NFAs were computationally designed and evaluated across six key parameters against Y6. Several candidates show strong electronic and photophysical properties, highlighting promise for next-generation organic electronics.
